title: Emerging music star Lloyd John releases highly anticipated “Move On”
htmlContent:
Emerging music star Lloyd John is a multi-talented singer and songwriter taking over the industry by storm, especially with the release of his recent track “Move on.” The high-rated star has built his fan base from scratch and is reaching new heights. 

In his recent track “Move On,” Lloyd John gives us the most authentic storytelling in his music. This energetic Alt Pop/Hiphop release captures anger and independence, giving the listener a hopeful lift and a chance to put any bad experiences behind them.
